changelog: fix: Re-render in R now hands over heatmaps and UPGMA trees, and adds the figures the editor had and R did not; job and results pages keep their actions top-right. (1) Seven figures were drawn by calling pdf() directly rather than through save_pdf(): the Bray-Curtis similarity heatmap, the UPGMA dendrograms (05 and 12), the beta heatmaps (17), the DESeq2 heatmap, and the base-graphics fallbacks for the network and LEfSe cladogram; the taxonomy heatmaps (04b) passed a .pdf filename to pheatmap and the cluster-tree bar figure called ggsave(device='pdf'). A re-render with --device png wrote all of these as PDFs into the PNG folder, where the listing only picks up *.png, so they never reached the download. They now go through open_dev()/save_pdf() and follow the device. (2) New R figures: 02_alpha_all_metrics (every alpha metric, one panel each, by group), 24 prevalence vs abundance (22_prevalence_abundance, one panel per group, prevalence computed within the group), and 22b_species_summary (taxa detected per sample at each rank plus ASVs, rows split by group; lineages counted, not names), with tables prevalence_abundance.csv and species_summary.csv. (3) Beta console: on the job page 'Settings this run used' comes before the pipeline and log, and View results / Download / Delete job (or Cancel job while running) sit top-right beside the job name; on the results page Customise charts and Download everything sit top-right. The delete confirmation opens at the top of the page. Verified: the new figures and open_dev() rendered from the U2BI-139 tables in R (png, pheatmap and base plot); viz_pipeline.R parses; 18 drivers, 590 checks.

previous.changelog: fix: R taxonomy bars split by group, group-level bars no longer collapse with a long legend; editor lists moved under the chart. (1) 04_taxonomy_* per-sample bars now draw one panel per group side by side (e.g. feed | Reactor) when a grouping is active, in the order the groups first appear in metadata.csv. (2) 04b_taxonomy_group_* used a fixed 6-inch page. With Top-50 the legend wrapped into three columns, took the whole page and ggplot drew the bars at zero width, so Class/Order/Family/Genus came out as a legend over an empty axis. Both bar figures now size the page from the legend's longest name and use a single-column legend, page height growing with the number of taxa. (3) Beta console: Colours, Groups and Samples are drawn in a panel under the chart, side by side, instead of at the bottom of the Customise panel; the Customise panel stays in view while scrolling. Includes 2.9.23: group-level bars sum within each sample before averaging (were 75-96% where a name spans several lineages), Other last and grey, and Save groups takes unticked samples out of the active grouping. Verified: both bar figures rendered with ggplot2 from the U2BI-139 tables at Top-50 (Class, Genus; group bars 100/100); viz_pipeline.R parses; 18 drivers, 584 checks.
